title: Writing Task 1 - Pie Chart: Transport Modes
description: IELTS Writing Task 1: Describe pie charts showing modes of transport used by commuters in two cities.

stimuli.title: Task 1: Commuter Transport Modes — London vs Singapore
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The pie charts below show the modes of transport used by commuters in London and Singapore in 2021.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Data — London: Car 34%, Underground 28%, Bus 21%, Cycling 9%, Walking 8%. Singapore: MRT/Bus 62%, Car 24%, Cycling 7%, Walking 7%.

questionGroups.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

questions.content: Describe the pie charts showing commuter transport modes in London and Singapore in 2021.

keyFeatures: Public transport was dominant in Singapore (62%) compared to London where car use led (34%)
London commuters had a more diverse spread across transport options
Private car use was notably higher in London than in Singapore (34% vs 24%)
Active transport (cycling and walking) accounted for similar proportions in both cities
